mapper.select: select id, announcement_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, deleted, create_time, update_time from tb_attachment where announcement_id = #{announcementId} and deleted = 0
select id, announcement_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, deleted, create_time, update_time from tb_attachment where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
